name: The Golem
palette: Muted earthy palette of wet clay browns, slate greys and moss greens, with warm rust-orange and amber accents.
character: THE GOLEM: a hulking, hunched construct with limbs of wet brown river clay and hands and head of mossy green-grey boulders, glowing orange cracks in the stone, held together by rusted iron bands and rivets, a single glowing amber eye in its boulder head.
icon_subject: the boulder head of the Golem with its glowing amber eye, front view
portrait: full portrait of the Golem standing, menacing but loyal, in a misty cave
banner: The Golem standing heroically on a pile of rubble at the base of a dark spire, looking up

overrides.strike_golem: Close-up of the Golem's clay arm entering from the lower left edge, ending in a huge boulder fist bound by a rusted iron wrist band, mossy stone with glowing orange cracks, punching diagonally up to the right. A small burst of rock chips and mud at the knuckles. Background: rust red with darker brown angular streaks.
overrides.defend_golem: The Golem seen from the front, crouched low behind its raised mossy boulder forearm, its amber eye peering over the top, bright light-beam attacks shattering against the stone in sparks. Background: flat slate blue field with darker angular streaks.
overrides.slam: The Golem's two huge boulder fists slamming down into the ground from above, a ring shockwave of mud and rock shards bursting outward, a faint stone barrier forming around it. Background: flat burnt orange field with darker angular streaks.
overrides.clay_arms: A thick arm of wet brown clay, freshly sculpted, with handprint marks pressed into it and a rusted iron band at the shoulder, glowing faintly amber at the seams. Background: flat dark navy field with darker angular streaks and a soft glow behind the subject.
overrides.rubble: A small heap of broken mossy stones and clay chunks, dust still settling, one chunk glinting orange. Background: flat earthy ochre field with darker angular streaks.
overrides.grind: Close-up of the Golem's boulder fist grinding against an enemy's dark armour plate, sparks and stone dust spraying, a few chips of rock forming a crust on the knuckles. Background: flat rust red field with darker angular streaks.
overrides.shoulder_charge: The Golem's huge rounded boulder shoulder with a rusted iron pauldron barrelling forward diagonally, motion arcs behind it, mud splashing. Background: flat deep ochre field with darker angular streaks.
overrides.pile_driver: A massive boulder fist driving straight down onto a cracked dark helmet, the ground splitting underneath, debris flying upward. Background: flat dark maroon field with darker angular streaks.
overrides.crumble: Close-up of the Golem's stone arm deliberately crumbling at the edge, chunks of rock peeling off and falling into the Golem's open clay palm. Background: flat cold teal field with darker angular streaks.
overrides.mud_wall: A wall of thick wet mud surging up from the ground in front of the viewer, enemy blades sinking and sticking in it, mud splattering. Background: flat steel blue field with darker angular streaks.
overrides.quarry: The Golem's clay fingers prying a glowing chunk of stone out of a rough rock face, small pebbles tumbling down. Background: flat earthy ochre field with darker angular streaks.
overrides.heavy_swing: The Golem's arm swinging a huge boulder fist in a wide horizontal arc, the whole frame filled with the fist, large motion arcs and flying gravel. Background: flat blood red fading to brown field with darker angular streaks.
overrides.clay_throw: A wet lump of clay flying through the air toward the upper right, trailing mud droplets, the Golem's open hand just visible at the lower left edge. Background: flat deep ochre field with darker angular streaks.
